prompts.title: Form: Recent Rhythm and Count Bars
prompts.prompt: Vertical 9:16. Two presentations, editorial first. EDITORIAL — Kinetic typography and rhythmic emphasis. Charcoal #101412 field. Warm white #edf0e6 type, lime #c5ed74 accents, slate #8ca6bf for secondary. Composition: three stacked word bands, each band a Spanish label: VICTORIAS, EMPATES, DERROTAS. Team names Athletic Club and Getafe CF enter as split-line lockups from left and right. On a steady beat, Spanish words snap in with a small lateral punch; lime underline sweeps under the active word, slate ghost type trails behind. No axes, no sample counts, no invented match events. Camera: slow push-in on the word stack, then a lateral whip-pan to the team lockups. Emphasis: the middle word EMPATES gets a held beat and a soft pulse, but keep hierarchy one focal point. Lower quarter reserved for permanent yellow subtitles, kept clear. Transition: on beat four, a lime vertical wipe transition to the statistical block. Exit: type collapses into a single lime line. STATISTICAL — Grouped count bars, shared zero baseline. Two team groups on x-axis: Athletic Club and Getafe CF. Three bars per group: Victorias {{home.wins}}, Empates {{home.draws}}, Derrotas {{home.losses}} for home; Victorias {{away.wins}}, Empates {{away.draws}}, Derrotas {{away.losses}} for away. Y-axis unit: partidos; ticks auto-generated by renderer from fact values, no hardcoded tick labels. Bars use lime for wins, warm white for draws, slate for losses; value labels sit at bar ends. Sample badges: muestra {{home.n}} partidos and muestra {{away.n}} partidos; if sample badges differ, keep them separate and do not imply equal weight. Source strip: Fuente: Bzzoiro. Spanish labels throughout. Entry: axis grows from zero, bars stagger upward in 120 ms steps. Main comparison: win and loss columns read side by side; emphasis on the tallest bar via lime halo. Camera: locked front view, subtle 2D parallax. Transition: bars settle, source strip slides in. Exit: wipe to charcoal. Lower quarter permanent yellow subtitles.

prompts.title: Goals: Pitch Path and For/Against Pairs
prompts.prompt: Vertical 9:16. EDITORIAL — Illustrative football pitch and ball path. Charcoal background, minimal pitch lines in slate #8ca6bf, warm white #edf0e6, lime #c5ed74. A stylized pitch is drawn in perspective; two abstract team markers labeled Athletic Club and Getafe CF sit at opposite ends. A lime ball traces a clean curved path across the pitch, leaving a thin warm-white trail; the path is decorative, not a real match event. Spanish headings GOLES A FAVOR and GOLES EN CONTRA slide in from the touchlines, set in condensed sports sans. No axes, no sample claims, no invented goals. Camera: slow overhead drift, then a gentle tilt down to the ball path. Emphasis: the ball path brightens at its apex, one focal point. Lower quarter reserved for permanent yellow subtitles. Transition: pitch lines sweep off as a lime curtain transition to the statistical block. Exit: ball exits frame, pitch dims. STATISTICAL — Paired horizontal bars for both teams, shared scale. Rows: Athletic Club a favor {{home.gf}}, Athletic Club en contra {{home.ga}}, Getafe CF a favor {{away.gf}}, Getafe CF en contra {{away.ga}}. Unit: goles. Common scale from zero to the maximum fact value, ticks auto-generated by renderer. Bars: a favor in lime, en contra in slate; team labels in Spanish, value labels at bar ends. Source strip: Fuente: Bzzoiro. Sample treatment: muestra indicada en la ficha de cada hecho; do not add rates. Spanish labels: Goles a favor, Goles en contra. Entry: zero line draws first, bars extend left-to-right in staggered sequence. Main comparison: same-team for/against pairs sit adjacent; cross-team comparison uses identical bar thickness. Emphasis: the longest bar gets a warm-white edge glow. Camera: locked, slight vertical pan following rows. Transition: source strip settles, then a soft dissolve. Exit: bars retract to zero line. Lower quarter permanent yellow subtitles.

prompts.title: Clean Sheets: Shield Energy and Count Tiles
prompts.prompt: Vertical 9:16. EDITORIAL — Defensive energy and stylised shield. Charcoal #101412 field. A large shield outline in warm white #edf0e6 with lime #c5ed74 inner edge, slate #8ca6bf shadow. Shield pulses like a heartbeat; two team labels Athletic Club and Getafe CF flank it. Spanish heading ARCOS EN CERO appears as chunky sport type. Abstract defensive blocks slide into the shield, then lock with a lime flash. No axes, no sample counts, no invented saves or match events. Camera: slow dolly-in on shield, then a small orbit to reveal depth. Emphasis: shield center holds one focal point; energy ripples outward. Lower quarter reserved for permanent yellow subtitles. Transition: shield splits into two vertical slats and slides apart as a transition to statistics. Exit: slats close into a thin lime line. STATISTICAL — Paired count tiles with sample badges, no rate conversion. Two large tiles: Athletic Club arcos en cero {{home.clean}}; Getafe CF arcos en cero {{away.clean}}. Unit: partidos. Each tile uses identical shield pictograms of the same size and spacing, one shield per clean sheet, arranged in a common count grid so counts share the same visual scale. Sample badges: muestra {{home.n}} partidos and muestra {{away.n}} partidos. Source strip: Fuente: Bzzoiro. Spanish labels: Arcos en cero, Muestra. Do not convert counts into rates or fractions. Entry: tile frames draw first, shield pictograms pop in one by one. Main comparison: side-by-side tile heights equal; the count is read through identical units. Emphasis: the larger count gets a lime base glow, not a different pictogram size. Camera: locked front view, slight parallax on source strip. Transition: badges slide under tiles, then a clean vertical wipe. Exit: tiles dim to charcoal. Lower quarter permanent yellow subtitles.

prompts.title: Head-to-Head: Visual Duel and Historical Stack
prompts.prompt: Vertical 9:16. EDITORIAL — Visual duel. Charcoal #101412 split diagonally: Athletic Club side in warm white #edf0e6 with lime #c5ed74 accent; Getafe CF side in slate #8ca6bf with warm white. Two abstract crest shapes face each other like a duel; a lime center line crackles. Spanish heading CRUCES PREVIOS enters in condensed uppercase. Team names land from opposite edges with a short impact shake; no axes, no sample counts, no invented results. Camera: lateral tracking shot from one crest to the other, then a quick settle at center. Emphasis: the center line is the focal point; crests keep equal visual weight. Lower quarter reserved for permanent yellow subtitles. Transition: center line expands into a horizontal bar as a transition to the statistical block. Exit: crests retreat off opposite edges. STATISTICAL — Horizontal stacked count bar for historical head-to-head, with total sample. One bar length equals {{h2h.total}} partidos. Segments in fixed order: Victorias Athletic Club {{h2h.homeWins}} in lime, Empates {{h2h.draws}} in warm white, Victorias Getafe CF {{h2h.awayWins}} in slate. Unit: partidos; scale from zero to total, ticks auto-generated by renderer from fact values. Labels inside or below segments in Spanish, with counts at segment centers where space allows. Source strip: Fuente: Bzzoiro · muestra histórica: {{h2h.total}} cruces. Historical data is not a forecast; no predictive language. Entry: total bar frame draws first, then segments grow in sequence. Main comparison: home wins versus away wins read against the shared total; draws remain visible between them. Emphasis: a thin warm-white outline separates segments, lime marker under Athletic Club wins. Camera: locked, slight horizontal pan along bar. Transition: source strip slides in, then a soft dissolve. Exit: bar collapses to center line. Lower quarter permanent yellow subtitles.
